Name: Touch UI Enhanced - Android
Author: Kuugleblitz
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]This mod improved on some of the UI, HUD and Controls on [b]Stardew Valley Android[/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][u]*1.3.0 Updates*[/u][/b]
- Added toggle for disabling split panel
- Added a dedicated special attack button
- Added a dedicated slingshot button
- Added a screenshot button and screenshot mode
- Added buttons legends to the mod's config page
- Removed inventory tab hud button
- Tool button now automatically switch and use the last selected or used tool
- Weapon, tool, and slingshot button now uses and changes to the actual item sprite
- Toggling on 12 Slots Toolbar now automatically disable vertical toolbar
- Toggling on Zoom Buttons now automatically disable pinch zoom
- Fixed custom controls scrambled when zooming in and ou
- And other fixes and tweaks
[/center]
[center]
[b]Features:[/b]
[u][b]User Interface[/b][/u]
- Split Item Panel
- Drop Item Button
- +/- Quantity Button on Shop and Craft Menus
- Double Tap to Move Item Across Inventories (include Shipping Bin, Geode Breaking, etc)

[u][b]HUD[/b]
[/u]- Menu Tab Shortcut
- Zoom Button
- Screenshot Button  [color=#00ff00]*new* [/color][/center]
[center]- Mod's control toggle button[/center]
[center]- 12 Slots Toolbar
- Top Left Health & Stamina bar and Message Box

[u][b]Controls[/b]
[/u]- New Joystick/Dpad and Buttons control:[/center]
[center]Slingshot Button [color=#00ff00]*new* [/color]
Special Attack Button [color=#00ff00]*new*[/color]
﻿Attack Button
﻿Use Tool Button
﻿Interact Button
﻿Toolbar Page Buttons
Toolbar Active Slot Switcher (L/R) Buttons
﻿Decor Buttons (Pick Up, Place, and Rotate)
﻿Item Stowing Button[/center]
[center]Auto Run Button[/center]
[center]﻿Adjustable Joystick / Dpad (Size and Deadzone)

- Invisible Buttons Control Adjustment (Left/Bottom Padding and Height)

- Better Slingshot control (using the new control)


[b]Installation:[/b]
Follow SMAPI For Android by NRTnarathip and Mod Installation Guide [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44436]Here[/url]


[b]Compatibility with other mods:
[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40226]UI Info Suite 2 Redux[/url] by Ekysoh ✅

Comment on posts tab to report any bugs, other mod compatibility issue and support, feature request, etc.[/center]


[center]=======================================================================================[/center]


[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b]HOW TO USE (v1.0.0)

[/b][/center]
[left][u][b]﻿Split Stack Item Panel:[/b][/u]
Tap on stack item > item tooltip & split item panel will show up >
enter the amount you want to split (-1, -5, +1, +5) > tap OK to split it or tap on green up arrow to put the selected amount to or from chest (fridge, etc)
*you still can longpress an item to split stack item

[u][b]Double tap to move item to or from chest:[/b][/u]
- Quickly double tap *unselected* item in your inventory or chest
- Also work in shipping bin and Clint's process geode menu

[u][b]Inventory and Chests Menu Changes:
[/b][/u]- You can no longer select and item and tap on an occupied or empty slot to move the item (you can only drag and drop or double tap)
- When tapping on an item, the tooltip will become visible and stays until you tap on an empty slot, the tooltip itself, or the menu container

[u][b]Drop Item:[/b][/u]
Tap on item in your inventory or chest > drop button will show up above the trash can > press the drop item button

[u][b]Using [/b][/u][u][b]+/- Quantity Button on Shop and Craft Menus:[/b][/u]
Select item to buy/sell or craft > -5, -1, +1, +5 will be visible above the buy/sell or craft button > enter the amount you want > press buy/sell or craft button

[u][b]Menu Tab Shortcut and Zoom Buttons:[/b][/u]
go to the mod's config page to show/hide the button (HUD Section) > button will be visible in the game HUD > press the button to instantly open that page in the menu, press the yellow -/+ button to zoom in or out the game world

[b][u]Toolbar
[/u]12 Slots Toolbar:[/b] enable the option in the mod's config page > it will limit the toolbar slot to only 12, activate toolbar page system, and disable toolbar swipe to scroll.
- You also can change the 12 Slots Toolbar position to the center, right, or left (default)

[b]Toolbar L/R Page Button:[/b] switch between toolbar page if 12 Slots Toolbar is enabled
- You also can change the toolbar page button position relative to the toolbar to the center, right, or left (default) and whether the toolbar page will cycle (loop) around or not in the mod's config page

[u][b]Using The New Joystick and Buttons Control:[/b]
[/u]- go to the mod's config page to enable the new control (Control Section > Use Mod's Controls)
*change the game control in the setting to "Joystick and Buttons" then move and resize the button to be away from the mod's new controls
- you can choose whether to use Dpad style movement control instead of joystick with knob
- adjust your desire size and deadzone for the joystick or dpad and whether or not the joystick continue if it out of bound (joystick size)
﻿
[u][b]Adjusting New Control Button and Joystick/Dpad Posistion:[/b][/u]
- press the "Adjust Joystick/Dpad and Button Position" > the menu will be close > now your in the game world, hold to drag each button to your desire position
*toggle on the decor button first (hammer button) to adjust the position of the "pick", "place", and "rotate" button >
after everything is how you want it press DONE on top of the screen to exit the control position adjustment mode

[u][b]What the New Control Buttons Do:[/b][/u]
[b]A / Use Tool ([i]Pickaxe Button[/i])[/b] = To Use Tools such as pickaxe, axe, watering can, hoe, fishing rod, weapon, etc (hold button to repeat or charge the tool)
[b]B / Interact ([i]Hand Grab Button[/i])[/b] = Use for interaction such as eat, pet, talk, pick up item from machine, open door, etc. Also use for weapon second attack option
[b]Attack / Weapon ([i]Sword Button[/i])[/b] = Instantly switch to the first weapon in your inventory and use the weapon (hold button to repeat)
[b]Item Stowing ([i]Downward Facing Chevron Button[/i])[/b] = Use for stowing active item in toolbar
[b]Toolbar Active Slot Switcher ([i]Left / Right Facing Chevron Buttons[/i]) [/b]= use for quickly switch (left or right) active slot in the toolbar without having to tap on the toolbar itself (can be hold too)
[b]Toolbar Page Switcher ([i]Left / Right Arrow Button[/i]) [/b]= Use for quickly swith between toolbar pages using "12 Slots Toolbar" option
[b]Decor Toggle ([i]Hammer Button[/i]) [/b]= Use to show or hide the decor buttons (pick, place, and rotate)
[b]Pick ([i]Right Pointing Hand Button[/i])[/b] = Use to pick decor item such as furniture, decoration, item from table, etc
[b]Place ([i]Down Pointing Hand Button[/i])[/b] = Use to place decor item such as furniture, decoration, item to table, etc
[b]Rotate ([i]Looping Arrow Button[/i])[/b] = Use to rotate decor item such as furniture, decoration, etc

[b]Invisible Buttons Adjustment
[/b]- If you using the game "Invisible Joystick & 2 Button" control option (note: disable the mod's new joystick and buttons control)
- You can adjust the right and bottom padding and the height of the 2 invisible buttons by going to the mod's config menu > Invisible Buttons section > enable "Adjust Invisible Button Bounds" option[/left]
